output.reason: Read alone, the cited item [ev-e9017907ef12] is just a metric name. Its section header [ev-1f419676f177] supplies the rest. It says the listed metrics, including this one, change their prefix from `cortex_` to `loki_` in 3.0.0, which would make this metric `loki_distributor_ingester_clients`. It also says the new `metrics_namespace` default is `loki`, and that setting it to `cortex` keeps the old prefix. That gives the subject (this metric), the change (a rename by prefix) and who is exposed (deployments that leave `metrics_namespace` at the default instead of setting `cortex`). The consequence is implied rather than stated: anything that queries the old `cortex_` name, such as dashboards or alerts, would no longer find this series after the upgrade.
